description: This Java source file defines the ModuleFilter class, which implements a servlet filter that allows modules to insert their own custom filters into the request processing chain within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: ModuleFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that delegates request processing to a chain of module-provided filters, facilitating dynamic filter injection by modules.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, logging a debug message.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the filter is destroyed, logging a debug message.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes each request by creating a ModuleFilterChain with module filters and passing control along that chain.
